# ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.1

Runs the classifier's CLIP model in the Chrome version of the eye (`web/js/eye/classifier-worker.js`), on the
CPU through WebAssembly, offline. From the npm package `onnxruntime-web@1.31.1`: `dist/ort.wasm.min.js`,
`dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs` and `dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm`, unchanged.
